notes: Editor gloss «يعني ابن الحارث» is left out.
كلاهما عن هشام: Khalid and Ibn Abi Adi both take from Hisham. Hisham is named once for both routes.

قال سمعت أبي: the father of Mu'tamir is named by relation only. Reading: the father and Mu'tamir both narrate from Qatada (جميعا حدثنا قتادة), so Qatada and Anas are the shared tail. The alternative reading (father as a co-transmitter at the Qatada level) is not chosen.
بهذه القصة is a pointer to the matn, not a chain item. The saying itself is not in the text.
